race.comment: ORDINARY ANGEL (4) is five runs into his maiden prep but keeps performing. Raced on the pace then dug deep to collect his maiden win last start over 1400m at Gunnedah. No reason he cannot take it to the next level here. ICHIKA (10) missed the kick and was behind the eight ball thereafter over the mile at Grafton last time out. Best form comes over today's journey so she can bounce back without surprising. AKAUWHEO (3) made it two wins from two visits to Quirindi when she defied all challengers over 1600m here 22 days ago. Four-time winner over today's trip so despite shouldering 61kgs her credentials are hard to fault. Veteran OENOLOGY (1) is racing well including a close fourth over 1400m at Tamworth last start. Needs the 4kg claim which should make him competitive again. GIDDY UP GRIFF (6) impressively won his maiden here over 1200m when resuming from a spell last time out. Lightly raced and has loads more upside than most of these but is very short.
